caseStudy.problem: A local-first Python telemetry and work-session service with explicit evidence, retention and mocked integration tests.
caseStudy.role: Personal project: implementation, integration and testing.
architecture: A Python package separates normalized event ingestion, work-session state, evidence exports and optional Notion writes. Tests use temporary directories and mocked remote calls.
validation: Public source includes documented focused test commands; see the repository validation notes for current results.
limitations: Development service. Configure private destinations locally; review optional integration and retention settings before use. No personal activity history is included.
